header: SQIsign_248: f=248, p = 5*2^248 - 1 (NIST security level I).
Negative and vulnerability test vectors for SQIsign_248 signing.
Signing is in flux; this file is a skeleton.
TODO categories (add vectors as signing stabilizes):
- SignVerifyRoundTrip: sign with our impl, verify with C ref (and vice versa).
- NonceIndependence: same (sk, msg) with different randomness -> distinct E_com.
- EmptyMessage: sign and verify empty message.
- ResponseEdgeCases: inputs that exercise r_rsp > 0, n_bt > 0, max lattice width.
- CornacchiaBranching: inputs that exercise different Cornacchia branches (SPA target).
- DegenerateIdeal: commitment ideal with pathological norm.

KatRoundTrip.description: Signature from C reference KAT file verifies under the paired pk. Tests the sign-then-verify contract without running our own signer.

SignVerifyRoundTrip.description: Sign with our implementation, verify the result. The fundamental correctness property.

NonceIndependence.description: Signing the same message twice with different randomness must produce distinct commitment curves. Nonce reuse leaks the secret key.

CornacchiaBranching.description: Inputs crafted so that the Cornacchia algorithm in RepresentInteger takes different branches. Detects implementations vulnerable to SPA.

ResponseEdgeCases.description: Signatures where r_rsp > 0 or n_bt > 0, exercising the even-response isogeny and backtracking paths that are absent in most KAT vectors.

DegenerateIdeal.description: Commitment ideal with pathological norm (e.g., norm dividing p, trivial generator). Tests whether signing rejects or handles gracefully.
